verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a one-shot chat command (with --max-new and --show-thinking) and an OpenAI-compatible server queried via curl. A single prompt-and-response invocation is a related but different capability from an interactive multi-turn chat session, and nothing shows a REPL or ongoing conversational mode in the terminal. Serving plus curl is a developer building block, and the macOS 'local CLI' mention does not describe interactive chat.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal
